punchline: Many people found one factory job deadening, but a worker on that line kept racing his own morning from the day before.
thirty_sec: Mihaly Csikszentmihalyi describes a factory worker whose job was the same movement for hours. Most people find work like that dull. This man set himself small targets: a batch in less time, fewer mistakes, a faster morning than yesterday's. Each finished piece told him how he was doing. Csikszentmihalyi calls it flow that the worker made himself.
